desc:
🏛️ BECOME THE LEADER OF A REAL COUNTRY!
Arrive in the presidential limousine 🚘, walk the red carpet and rule your nation from your own office. Every choice changes your country!

🌍 10 COUNTRIES – EACH WITH ITS OWN WORLD
🏔️ Switzerland · 🏜️ Somalia · 🐫 Egypt · 🌸 Japan · 🌴 Brazil · ❄️ Canada · 🍂 Germany · ☔ United Kingdom · 🗼 France · 🦅 USA

👔 HOW TO PLAY
💰 Set taxes and grow your economy
⚖️ Pass laws – some are totally crazy!
🗣️ Advisors visit you with tough (and funny) questions
⚔️ Build an army and conquer other countries
🖥️ Run everything from your Government PC
📉 Watch out: if your people get angry, your country collapses!

🎲 Roll the dice for a random country – or pick your favorite!
👑 Can you become the greatest leader in history?

👍 Like the game and add it to your favorites for new updates!

🗺️ Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors
